name: Enhance Ability
material: fur or feather from a beast
description:
You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects:
- **Bear's Endurance.** The target has advantage on Constitution checks and Fortitude saving throws. It also gains 2d6 temporary hit points, which are lost when the spell ends.
- **Bull's Strength.** The target has advantage on Strength checks and Fortitude saving throws, and their carrying capacity doubles.
- **Cat's Grace.** The target has advantage on Dexterity checks and Reflex saving throws. It also doesn't take damage from falling 20 feet or less if it isn't incapacitated.
- **Eagle's Splendor.** The target has advantage on Charisma checks and Will saving throws.
- **Fox's Cunning.** The target has advantage on Intelligence checks and Will saving throws.
- **Owl's Wisdom.** The target has advantage on Wisdom checks and Reflex saving throws.

**At Higher Levels.** When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.
